title: Fredo Job Stills
eyebrow: BadCode Shorts · The Fredo Job · stills round 2
heading: The Fredo Job: stills, round 2
intro: A slick heist crew of four BadCode balaclavas plans the job of the century: one chocolate frog in a corner-shop jar. 10p when they started planning (until 2005); 39p today. Way out (Jack's pick): money that keeps up, tried three ways at the bottom. Every still follows a real Unsplash photo's layout; prompts by a sealed writer. Price tags and boards are blank on purpose: words go in after. Pick one per row and leave a note.

sections.lede: Every shot re-made with the re-cast crew (Jack's note). Claude's picks marked; problems flagged on the still.
